evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex tearing and maceration of the body of medial meniscus with severe extrusion.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Inner margin blunting of the body of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Moderate cartilage loss throughout the medial compartment.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Moderate cartilage loss with areas of full-thickness fissuring throughout the lateral compartment.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage loss throughout the lateral patellar median ridge and medial patella with subchondral cystic change.
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
